decision.reason: [ev-a94d677cfc9f] is a one-line highlight. It says only that a new capability exists (global SOPS Age decryption keys for `Kustomization` on single-tenant clusters). It does not say how the keys are configured: no controller flag, secret name, key or CRD field is given, so there is no concrete subject or exposure condition to type. The rest of the section is other one-line highlights that add nothing about this mechanism. The one concrete subject proposed (spec.decryption.sopsAgeKeys) was refuted against the CRD schemas [ev-782bc47d120d][ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. To write the assertion, we need the kustomize-controller changelog, docs or the PR that names the configuration and says what happens when it is not set.
